questions.prompt: Which state of matter keeps its shape and its volume?
questions.explanation: Particles in a solid are packed tightly and only vibrate in place.

questions.prompt: Water boils at how many degrees Celsius at sea level?
questions.explanation: At sea level, water boils at $100\,^\circ\text{C}$.

questions.prompt: Ice turning into water is called \_\_.
questions.explanation: Solid to liquid is melting. The reverse is freezing.

questions.prompt: Match each formula with its substance.
questions.explanation: The subscript counts atoms of the element before it.

questions.prompt: Put the water cycle in order.
questions.explanation: Heat lifts water up, cooling forms clouds, and gravity brings it back.
